high_level_description: The image depicts a fashion model walking down a runway during what appears to be a fashion show. The model is wearing an elegant, traditional Indian outfit consisting of a lehenga and blouse. The lehenga is light-colored, possibly cream or off-white, with intricate gold sequin embellishments scattered across the fabric. The blouse is also light-colored and features detailed embroidery around the neckline. The model is accessorized with a statement necklace that has green gemstones, matching earrings, and a bracelet on her left wrist.
